# Gaurav Malode

> Software developer in Nashik, India. Official site: https://gauravmalode.in

Gaurav Malode builds secure financial software — from Flutter and React Native mobile apps to Node.js and FastAPI services. He ships production products for fintech and enterprise banking, including a halal investing app with 1.4M+ downloads across 200+ countries, enterprise apps (HDFC MyBuddy security, HDFC CasaGuru CASA learning), a Flutter desktop market-data product (Stock Terminal), and Stolity (a consumer React Native file-management app).
